replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body: It does seem kinda plain, and I feel like it would have similar gameplay to Curabitur, seeing that the positioning of the iron, spawns, and monuments are very similar to that map. I would recommend adding a bit more detail, and definitely expanding the monument islands more. Maybe try moving the monuments to a different location? Right now it seems like they'll be really hard to get to, and way too easy to defend. Fix those and you have my +1 :)

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map looks quite plain. It also has a bit of a weird block palette that I don't really like.

Some improvements to the islands would be rounding up the corners a bit and making it less flat. Add more decoration and some height changes on the front islands. That will improve your map a lot.

The map also seems a bit small. Mixing that with the amount of diamonds you have on the map and I don't think it will work out that well when it comes to gameplay.

Gameplay could be improved by making it easier to get the iron and making it more visible. Remove diamonds because they will be quite overpowered. Make the islands with the monuments a bit bigger. Other than that I like the layout you have.

One more thing that I dislike though is the staircase you have. There is no need for it. Maybe have a jump or just connect the islands with a bridge / have them on the same height level. It looks a bit weird ATM.

So the aesthetics need some improvements. Gameplay would probably be decent but it will be confusing for newer players due to the location of the iron.

Theres potential in this but it needs improvements.
